content:
noah: help — my bearded dragon knocked over my snake plant and the pot water seeped into my keyboard during a call 😭 pics: https://imgur.com/a/4k9dPqB

liz: oh noooo :scream: unplug it, take out keycaps if possible, and dry with rice or silica gel. any sign of shorting?

noah: spacebar is sticky, a couple keys register twice sometimes. it's a wireless mech (hot-swap). already powered it down and removed batteries.

sam: if it's hot-swap you can pull the switches and clean under them. otherwise compressed air + isopropyl wipes usually helps. i can ship a spare TKL keyset if needed.

noah: thanks! also weird side effect — after the spill my WiFi started dropping when dragon is on the desk. moved the router to a top shelf and speeds actually improved. speedtest attached: 28ms / 120Mbps down / 18Mbps up.

ops-bot: Reminder: office router firmware update tonight at 02:00 PDT. Expected brief blips for those on the 2.4GHz guest network.

maya: pro tip: silicone keyboard cover + small raised desk lip. also consider a cheap camera to catch them in the act 😂

noah: poll: should i get a desk mat with raised edge or a glass panel? react with :seedling: for mat, :thinking_face: for glass

liz: :seedling: mat — less fragile and warmer for dragon toes

sam: :seedling: mat (and i have a spare TKL keyset, @noah dm me your address)

noah: appreciate it! will attempt a gentle clean and report back with before/after + dragon photo 🦎
